card.text: The coldest exoplanet photographed so far, 275 K, circling one of the nearest Sun-like stars.

sources.label: Kravtchenko et al. 2026
sources.quote: Epsilon Indi Ab is currently the coldest, and one of the closest, directly imaged exoplanets

introduction.text: Epsilon Indi Ab is a cold giant planet about 16 au from its star. JWST first imaged it in 2023, and has since taken the longest-wavelength image of any exoplanet.

sources.label: Matthews et al. 2024
sources.quote: Here we report JWST coronagraphic images that reveal a giant exoplanet

sources.label: Sanghi et al. 2026
sources.quote: The F2550W detection of $ε$ Ind Ab constitutes the longest wavelength image of an exoplanet acquired to date

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
